prFooter: Refs #67: the standing issue for dependency updates, which the issue-link check requires every pull request to name.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch, minor and digest updates once CI is green. Nothing here reaches a user until it is vendored into a consumer and passes that consumer's release path, so a green run is a stronger signal here than in a consumer.

The shellcheck image is the one pin in a code file (shared/packaging/shellcheck-all.sh), so its PR needs the tests-with-code escape hatch. The job that runs the new image (Tests / Shell scripts) is not a required check, so a person merges it after reading that job.
prBodyNotes: No tests: an image pin bump; the Shell scripts job runs shellcheck-all.sh with the new image on this pull request. That job is not required, so check it passed before merging.

packageRules.description: setup-python installs from actions/python-versions' manifest, which lands over an hour after the CPython release Renovate reads. A bump raised in that gap fails every Python job at setup, so hold it until the manifest is certain to list it.
prBodyNotes: Held three days after the CPython release, so setup-python's manifest lists it before this runs.

packageRules.description: The gitleaks download is checked against GITLEAKS_SHA256 beside it, which Renovate cannot compute, so the bump PR fails the Secrets job until a person updates the checksum. Never automerge it.
prBodyNotes: Set `GITLEAKS_SHA256` in `.forgejo/workflows/gate-lint.yml` to the checksum of `gitleaks_<version>_linux_x64.tar.gz` from the release's checksums file before merging; the Secrets job fails until then.

customManagers.description: Pinned container images inside the shared scripts. They are bumped here and nowhere else: a consumer that bumped its vendored copy would fail its own drift check, so the bump reaches consumers as a re-vendor.
Version pins annotated with a `# renovate:` comment in the workflows. The annotation is the anchor; the same shape as the consumers', so a pattern learned in one repo reads the same in all.
